body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Ignore 1 additional point of cover bonus.
On a hit, push the target 1 unit sideways along a clear path.

rider.title: Lock - Trickshot
rider.html: After resolving, you may move 1 unit while keeping a Locked target visible. This movement cannot pass through enemies.
